genuine_defect_found.title: stack-launcher crashes with an unhandled EPIPE when the native parent closes the bootstrap pipe before the pairing write
genuine_defect_found.behavior: process.stdout.write() on the dead parent pipe raises ERR_STREAM_WRITE_AFTER_END/EPIPE as an unhandled 'error' event; the launcher dies with a Node.js stack trace instead of taking the parent-death path (the watchdog at desktop/stack-launcher.mjs:112-120 covers only the periodic ppid check).
genuine_defect_found.impact: when the app exits between stack readiness and the pairing write, the launcher crashes and its children churn/restart until retries exhaust; observed as transient stack restart loops and zombie facade/legacy writes in the staged logs.
genuine_defect_found.proposed_fix: wrap the pairing write; on EPIPE treat it as parent death and call stop(0) through the existing watchdog path (bounded, no behavior change when the pipe is healthy). Product code is frozen at 1a7f80e — fix requires operator approval and a rebuild (invalidates the built artifact and the affected acceptance results).
